<findings>
<finding task="0"><quote>R3.8 The runner passes its environment to every run unchanged.</quote><plan>## Decisions</plan><fix>Add the required `## Review Focus` section between Global Constraints and Decisions. List the five uncovered failure modes most likely to bite a user. Candidates: a run's environment reaching pytest unchanged (R3.8, e.g. `CALIBRATION_SWEEP=1`); the runner invoked from a directory other than the repo root (R3.1); `--list` and `--all` on an invalid registry; a tracked test file deleted from the working tree; plan 52's suite appearing mid-execution. Pin each with a test in the owning task, e.g. in Task 4 a `run_subprocess` test that sets an env var and a `main` test run with `monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)`. The plan's own Self-review section should also gain the Review Focus and Proportion checks.</fix></finding>
<finding task="2"><quote>`build/run_suites.py` (stdlib only) lists the suites, runs one or more of them, runs all of them, and checks the registry.</quote><plan>**Placeholders.** None. Each code step shows the code, and each run step shows the command and its expected output.</plan><fix>Tasks 2–4 transcribe the whole module (`validate`, `parse`, `runs`, `container`, `git_env`, `pytest_dirs`, `check`, `execute`, `list_suites`, `parse_args`, `main`). The plan is near or above five times the spec's length. Replace each code step with the signature, the constants and values the spec pins, and the output strings. Keep a body only where signature and tests leave a real choice: the `dir` normalisation rule (DF2), the deleted-file filter in `pytest_dirs`, and `git_env`'s variable stripping. The tests and the exact copy (BLOCK, CLAUDE.md and build/CLAUDE.md replacements) stay.</fix></finding>
<finding task="4"><quote>validation: each R3.9 failure, with exit 2;</quote><plan>def test_an_invalid_registry_stops_a_run_with_exit_2(repo, capsys):</plan><fix>R3.9 says validation stops `--list`, a named run and `--all` with exit 2, and R6.1 asks for each failure with exit 2. Only one failure (an unknown key) is checked through `main`, and only for a named run. Parametrize this test over the modes `['outer']`, `['--list']` and `['--all']`, and over a representative set of R3.9 failures (missing key, wrong type, duplicate name, `with` without pytest). Assert exit 2 and that no run starts.</fix></finding>
<finding task="6"><quote>R5.3 `build/CLAUDE.md`: "the eight commit lints" becomes "the nine commit lints", and one sentence names `suites.toml` and `run_suites.py` and says that `--check` is a commit lint.</quote><plan>`run_suites.py --check` is a commit lint: it fails when a directory that holds</plan><fix>The plan adds a two-sentence paragraph where the spec, and R7.3's coupling with plan 51 ("adds a sentence"), call for one sentence. Either merge it into one sentence naming `suites.toml`, `run_suites.py`, and `--check` as a commit lint, or log a decision with a spec amendment for R5.3 and R7.3. Then fix the Couplings bullet, which says "adds a paragraph", to match.</fix></finding>
<finding task="6"><quote>R6.3 Write each test before its code and see it fail first (red, then green).</quote><plan>Expected: every test passes, +1 on the Task 1 base.</plan><fix>Task 1 records no `test_commit_lints.py` count, so "+1 on the Task 1 base" cannot be checked. Add a Task 1 step that runs `uv run --directory build --python 3.13 --with pytest --with pyyaml python -m pytest -q test_commit_lints.py` and records its summary line. Alternatively, state the expected pass count here.</fix></finding>
<finding task="7"><quote>Then run `--all` once, and record each run's result beside the direct result.</quote><plan>The last line is `suite runs passed`.</plan><fix>Step 3 checks only the last line. Add an instruction to record each `--all` run's pass or fail beside the Step 2 direct result for the completion report, `cc_guide` marked as skipped. Step 2's "Write the 18 result pairs down" should read "one pair per registered suite (19 with plan 52's entry)".</fix></finding>
<finding task="0"><quote>6. The shared note for plan 52 (R7.1) is written.</quote><plan>Check that the shared notes folder of this plan's session group still has `plan-54-suite-registry-for-plan-52.md`, with plan 52's entry (Couplings).</plan><fix>No step writes the note; the completion step only checks for it, with no action if it is missing. Add a step, in Task 5 after the registry lands or in Plan completion, that writes (or rewrites) the note with the exact `[[suite]]` entry from Couplings and confirms it. Keep the "already landed" alternative.</fix></finding>
</findings>
